revisions.goal: Eliminate sustained idle CPU caused by legacy or stale UI polling by making runtime derivation caching event-generation driven instead of expiring every two seconds, while preserving recovery from missed watcher events and validating real process CPU behavior.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: Repeated API request waves without runtime events reuse derived repository data and do not relaunch Git work; filesystem and agent lifecycle events still invalidate affected runtime views; the local UI remains event-driven and hidden views stay disconnected; an end-to-end idle benchmark shows near-zero backend CPU after warmup even with legacy polling traffic; Go, race, vet, UI tests, and production build pass.

milestones.title: Lock regression signal
milestones.goal: Add a focused test that simulates repeated stale-client requests and proves derived loaders run once per event generation.

milestones.title: Make cache event-driven
milestones.goal: Remove short wall-clock expiry from successful derived entries while retaining singleflight, cancellation, and explicit invalidation through event generations.

milestones.title: Verify runtime behavior
milestones.goal: Run full tests and a live CPU/request benchmark against the optimized daemon, then record the change in EVE.

revisions.configuredSuite: go test ./... && go test -race ./cmd/eve && go vet ./... && cd ui && npm test && npm run build
